evidence_class: Fresh packaged-source reconstruction, standard comparison, and two-kernel replay
tool_provenance: Exact previously built compatible binaries, verified against retained input manifest
toolchain_compatibility: Unchanged Comparator and lean4export sources built with Lean 4.34.1; the Comparator checkout declares 4.35.0-rc4.

dependency_policy.cache: Fresh official Mathlib cache fetch; no candidate code during setup
dependency_policy.source_build_scope: Packaged proof modules only; upstream Mathlib/Lean use trusted compiled artifacts

rebuild.configuration: Generated and reviewed, frozen submitted config retained separately

boundary_controls.scope: Real compiler invocation: allowed build write, protected challenge/config/tool/outside/symlink writes, and Unix stream/datagram socket creation.

diagnostic_review.valid_control: Both actual pinned kernels accepted the unmodified fixture export.
diagnostic_review.lean_rejection: Explicit declaration type mismatch for validation_control, Prop versus True.
diagnostic_review.nanoda_rejection: Typechecker assert_def_eq failed at pinned src/tc.rs:955; exit 101.
diagnostic_review.nanoda_source_review: Pinned source line 955 is assert!(self.def_eq(u,v)); input mutation changes only the theorem value to its type expression.
diagnostic_review.scope: Parsed ill-typed proof rejection using controlled exporter injection; not the candidate proof route.
diagnostic_review.limits: One specific ill-typed proof control; not a universal checker soundness test.

proof_body_controls.scope: One parsed theorem-value mutation, True.intro to True; fixture exporter confined to separate control projects.
proof_body_controls.excluded_attempt: An earlier fixture omitted required builtin constants and failed before either kernel; no rejection evidence is attributed to it.

runner_revisions.correction: Allow execution of the identified Lean toolchain in later library-build/audit Landrun calls; preserve read-only tool access.

supplementary_build_recovery.reason: Lake library defaults select root modules; explicit frozen module targets are required for the complete source sweep.

runtime_resource_adjustment.scope: Increase build/check CPU allowance from four to six of eight available cores; no input, tool, memory, filesystem, or network policy change.

retention: Original logs, source/config identities, dependency inventory and exact checker input retained privately; published log derivatives replace local filesystem paths.
limits: Lean, Mathlib and checking-tool binaries remain trusted inputs; this is not a source bootstrap of the toolchain or all upstream dependencies.
Nanoda and Lean replay share the lean4export input and Comparator frontend.
Controls establish the observed cases, not universal sandbox or checker soundness.
Exact retained checker exports have no public download; no public retrieval test was performed.
Formal acceptance does not establish novelty, manuscript correspondence, or human peer review.
